api_id.description: Identifier to assign to the API. Must be unique within scope of the parent resource(project)
api_id.rationale: Identifies the parent API for context only. It does not assign access or modify permissions, so it has no direct security effect.

display_name.description: A user-visible name for the API.
display_name.rationale: A user-visible name does not affect security posture as it is only for display purposes.

managed_service.description: Immutable. The name of a Google Managed Service ( https://cloud.google.com/service-infrastructure/docs/glossary#managed). If not specified, a new Service will automatically be created in the same project as this API.
managed_service.rationale: The managed service name is an immutable identifier and does not affect security posture directly.

labels.description: Resource labels to represent user-provided metadata. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration. Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Labels are used for governance tracking and security classification. They indicate environment, ownership, cost allocation, and API sensitivity, supporting auditing and compliance requirements.
labels.compliant: Must include all required labels: environment, owner, sensitivity, cost_center. Allowed values include environment=[production, staging, qa, development] and sensitivity=[public, internal, confidential, restricted]. Example: environment=production, owner=team-a, sensitivity=restricted, cost_center=cc-1234.
labels.non-compliant: Missing one or more required labels (environment, owner, sensitivity, cost_center). Using disallowed values such as environment=prod or sensitivity=top-secret. Empty or undefined label values.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
